N.role: NEGATIVE CONTROL — a re-run of C; must be bit-exact (E4)

S.role: sensitivity — every in-window chunk of the new index (exact search)

T.role: primary treatment — where §I61 found the dimension stops mattering

meta.graph_lane: NOT included — it fires on multihop only and is a second lever
meta.hyde: OFF — deliberately, so every arm shares one query vector (pre-registration §4). The DELTA is unaffected; the ABSOLUTE numbers are not production numbers.

reranker_swallow.why_it_matters: ClusterCrossEncoderReranker.rerank swallows every failure and returns the pool UNRANKED (§I55), which makes a top-k comparison on that query inert by construction. Named and excluded from the headline, per pre-registration §6.5.

meta.what: §I61 — the pre-registered A/B on the product retrieval path: does raising the 64d prefetch limit (1000 -> 2000) improve the endpoint the product ships?

mechanism_M1.unit: `dense_64` lane, `limit` in CHUNKS, recall over the deduped PAGE pool intersected with the query's REACHABLE labelled pages (§I61's convention)
mechanism_M1.why: the causal chain: §I61 measured this on a 40-query screening subsample; this re-derives it at n=133. It must move in the §I61 direction, or the A/B's premise is wrong (pre-registration §6.6).

negative_control_E4.note: arm N re-runs arm C with HyDE off, so the only legitimate source of a difference is instrument noise. Any mismatch voids the A/B (pre-registration §7 E4).

power.note: n is fixed (every answerable text query), so power is reported, not chosen. §D9/§2 convention: n = ceil((1.96·SD/δ)²).
